title: Build HuffmanTree class in compressor.py
body: Added HuffmanTree class with build/encode/decode/from_dict methods. Lossless prefix coding for uint8 arrays.

title: Improve Lloyd's: k-means++ init, adaptive iterations
body: Replaced quantile init with k-means++ (sample-based for speed). Added early stopping on inertia convergence. Improved accuracy from 99.23% to 99.98% at k=128.

title: Wire Huffman into compress_cluster + Point.generate
body: compress_cluster now builds Huffman tree and encodes assignments. Point.generate decodes Huffman bitstream before centroid lookup. Roundtrip verified lossless.

title: Benchmark: Lloyd+Huffman vs Q4 block
body: Lloyd+Huff k=64: 99.89% cosine, 5.6:1 ratio. Q4 block: 99.42% cosine, 5.3:1 ratio. Lloyd+Huffman wins on BOTH accuracy and ratio.

title: Write API docs for pugqeep
body: Wrote API.md covering Point, Tree, ModelTree, PointLibrary, PointCompressor, PGQ, ModelQueue, Config. Simple usage examples for every class. Benchmarks included.

title: Add nbytes support for block_q4/block_q8
body: Point.nbytes() now returns correct size for block_q4 and block_q8 function types (mins + scales + packed/values).
